The Monitor is a monthly issue on what populist actors did around the world. It is neutral, analytical and sourced. Populism is the object of study, never the target.

## Issues

::: {#issues}
:::

::: {.pv-pending}
The first issue, 2027/1, is planned for January 2027.
:::

## What is in an issue

1. **Editor's note.** The month's main story.
2. **Around the world.** Six regional roundups: Europe; North America; Latin America; Asia-Pacific; Middle East and North Africa; Sub-Saharan Africa.
3. **In focus.** One theme a month: an election, populists in government, a foreign or defence policy move.
4. **New research.** Papers added to the [Library](../library/index.qmd) that month.
5. **Coming up.** Elections, conferences and calls for papers in the next two months.

## Web page and PDF

Every issue is published twice from the same text: as a web page and as a typeset PDF. The PDF is the version of record. The web page shows the PDF's page numbers in the margin, so a passage can be cited by page from either one. Each issue has its own DOI.

## How to cite

Author (year), "Title", *PopuliVerse Monitor* 2027/1, pp. x–y, DOI.

Issues are numbered by year: 2027/1, 2027/2 and so on. The Monitor is published under a [CC BY 4.0 licence](../legal/licence.qmd).
